title: Students protest RSS leader's presence at Central University of Kerala seminar
seoTitle: Kasaragod students protest RSS leader's presence

tea.why: Students protested a seminar on Vande Mataram, alleging it was part of a "saffronisation agenda" and featured speakers with ideological links to the RSS.
tea.want: They demanded universities offer equal ideological space, not be used for political agendas, and objected to RSS-linked speakers.
tea.changed: Oct 6: Police physically removed protesters from the Central University of Kerala campus after clashes.

summary: On October 6, 2026, students from SFI, NSUI, MSF, AISF, and KSU protested at the Central University of Kerala in Kasaragod. They opposed a national seminar on Vande Mataram, alleging it was part of a "saffronisation agenda" and featured speakers linked to the RSS, such as J. Nandakumar. Protesters attempted to enter the seminar hall but were prevented by police, leading to scuffles. Students demanded that universities provide equal space for all ideological viewpoints and avoid political agendas. Police reportedly removed agitators from the area around 2 pm. Four students were reported injured, though police denied injuries.

injuries.text: Four students were reportedly injured during clashes between the police and student protesters

updates.text: Students from SFI, NSUI, MSF, AISF, and KSU protested at Central University of Kerala against a Vande Mataram seminar and RSS-linked speakers.
Protesters attempted to enter the seminar hall but were prevented by police, leading to scuffles on campus.
Four students were reportedly injured during clashes with police, though police, according to siasat.com, denied any injuries occurred.
Police physically removed agitators from the area around 2 pm, ending the protest.
Veteran CPI(M) leader Pinarayi Vijayan criticized police for providing security to the event and alleged government collusion.
